sentences.en: As many of you here today have worked in the hotel industry for some time, I'm sure you have experienced the problem of high staff turnover in your hotels.
sentences.zh: 在座各位中，许多人已在酒店行业工作了一段时间，我相信你们一定经历过酒店员工高流动率的问题。

sentences.en: Every hotel relies on having loyal and experienced members of staff who make sure that everything runs smoothly.
sentences.zh: 每家酒店都依赖忠诚且经验丰富的员工，以确保一切运营顺畅。

sentences.en: If staff are constantly changing, it can make life difficult for everyone.
sentences.zh: 如果员工频繁更替，会给所有人带来诸多困难。

sentences.en: But why do staff leave frequently in many hotels?
sentences.zh: 但为什么许多酒店的员工会频繁离职呢？

sentences.en: Of course, many hotel jobs, such as cleaning, are low-skilled and are not well-paid.
sentences.zh: 当然，许多酒店岗位（例如清洁工作）属于低技能岗位，且薪酬不高。

sentences.en: A lot of managers think it's this and the long hours that are the main causes of high staff turnover – but what they don't realise is that it's the lack of training in many hotel jobs which is a huge factor.
sentences.zh: 很多管理者认为，正是这一点以及长时间工作，是导致员工高流动率的主要原因；但他们没有意识到的是，酒店许多岗位缺乏培训才是一个巨大的影响因素。

sentences.en: So, what kind of problems does a high turnover of staff cause?
sentences.zh: 那么，员工高流动率会引发哪些问题呢？

sentences.en: Well, having to recruit new staff all the time can be very time-consuming, and managers may have to cover some duties while waiting for new staff to arrive.
sentences.zh: 首先，持续招聘新员工会耗费大量时间；而等待新员工到岗期间，管理人员可能不得不临时承担部分工作职责。

sentences.en: This means they don't have time to think about less immediate problems such as how to improve their service.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们无暇思考一些不那么紧迫的问题，例如如何提升服务质量。

sentences.en: When staff leave, it can also severely affect the colleagues they leave behind.
sentences.zh: 员工离职还会严重影响他们留下的同事。

sentences.en: It has a negative effect on remaining staff, who may start to feel that they too should be thinking about leaving.
sentences.zh: 这对留任员工会产生负面影响，使他们也开始考虑自己是否也该离职。

sentences.en: So, what can be done to change this situation?
sentences.zh: 那么，该如何改变这一状况呢？

sentences.en: Firstly, managers should stop making basic errors which leave their staff feeling upset and resentful.
sentences.zh: 首先，管理者应停止犯下一些基础性错误，以免让员工感到沮丧和不满。

sentences.en: When organising shifts, for example, make sure you never give certain staff preferential treatment.
sentences.zh: 例如，在排班时，务必确保绝不给予某些员工特殊优待。

sentences.en: All staff should be given some choice about when they work, and everyone should have to work some evening and weekend shifts.
sentences.zh: 所有员工都应拥有一定的排班选择权，且每个人都需承担部分晚间及周末班次。

sentences.en: If you treat staff fairly, they'll be more likely to step in and help when extra staff are needed.
sentences.zh: 如果您公平对待员工，当需要额外人手时，他们就更有可能主动伸出援手。

sentences.en: Keeping staff happy has other tangible benefits for the business.
sentences.zh: 让员工保持满意，还能为企业带来其他切实可感的益处。

sentences.en: Take the Dunwich Hotel as an example.
sentences.zh: 以邓威奇酒店（Dunwich Hotel）为例。

sentences.en: It had been experiencing a problem with staff complaints and in order to deal with this, invested in staff training and improved staff conditions.
sentences.zh: 该酒店曾长期面临员工投诉问题；为解决这一问题，酒店投资加强了员工培训并改善了员工工作条件。

sentences.en: Not only did the level of complaints fall, but they also noticed a significant increase in the amount each customer spent during their stay.
sentences.zh: 结果不仅投诉量大幅下降，他们还注意到每位顾客在店期间的平均消费额显著上升。

sentences.en: They have now introduced a customer loyalty scheme which is going really well.
sentences.zh: 目前，他们已推出一项客户忠诚计划，效果非常好。

sentences.en: Now I'd like to look at some ways you can reduce staff turnover in your hotels, and I'll do this by giving some examples of hotels where I've done some training recently.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想通过介绍近期我为几家酒店开展培训的实际案例，来探讨一些降低贵酒店员工流动率的方法。

sentences.en: The Sun Club received feedback which showed that staff thought managers didn't value their opinions.
sentences.zh: 太阳俱乐部收到了反馈，显示员工认为经理并不重视他们的意见。

sentences.en: They weren't made to feel they were partners who were contributing to the success of the business as a whole.
sentences.zh: 他们没有被当作是为整个企业成功做出贡献的合作伙伴。

sentences.en: This situation has changed.
sentences.zh: 这种情况已经发生了改变。

sentences.en: Junior staff at all levels are regularly invited to meetings where their ideas are welcomed.
sentences.zh: 所有级别的初级员工都会定期受邀参加会议，他们的想法受到欢迎。
